brief: blind judge of prose comparison packs (RI-MTH03), fresh context, no browser
findings: SAMPLING RULE, DECLARED BEFORE SAMPLING (2026-08-07): (1) I answer ALL 20 available blind trials - reports/packs/prose-tics-r2/ t01..t15 and reports/packs/prose-tics-voice-r2/ t01..t05 - in directory order, writing answer.md into each trial dir. No cherry-picking, no dropping a trial I find hard. (2) I open NO file under any *.reveal/ directory, and no builder report (reports/prose-tics/W1-PROSE-TICS-report.md), until all 20 answer.md files exist on disk. (3) For the rewrite judgement I take the 180 spoken-register rewrites from reports/prose-tics/rewrites/dialogue-0{3,4,5,6}*.jsonl and sample the FIRST 10 and LAST 10 records of the largest file plus 5 from each other file - a positional rule, not a taste rule. (4) For the post-sweep quest material I take the topics files whose mtime/git-add postdates the prose pass, list them mechanically, and read the 3 largest by info count in full plus every info containing 'eleven'. (5) Martial library: inspect for completeness only, judge nothing unfinished.

Pack inventory: prose-tics-r2 = 15 trials (t01-t05 books, t06-t10 dialogue, t11-t15 journal), seed 20260807. prose-tics-voice-r2 = 5 dialogue trials, seed 20260808. Reveal keys are siblings, not children - RI-MTH03 A satisfied.
next_step: judge the 180 rewrites (git before/after), then the post-sweep quest topics, then martial library completeness; then write the verdict
findings_2: RESULT: 20/20 CORRECT across both packs (15 + 5). Answers written and sha256'd BEFORE the reveal was opened. Chance p = 2^-20 = 9.5e-07. All picks were 'ours'.

THE QUESTION FORM MATTERS AND RI-MTH03 SEC E DOES NOT APPLY CLEANLY. The packs ask 'Which of these two is the imitation?' - a PROVENANCE question. The protocol's default text question is 'which was written by a game writer for a shipped RPG, and which is placeholder?' - a QUALITY question. Under a provenance question, picking ours is always 'correct', so the sec E rows 'picked-reference / picked-ours' cannot both be reachable and the 'if the critic picks ours, distrust the critic' rule is inoperative. What these packs measure is DISTINGUISHABILITY, not inferiority. 20/20 must not be read as 'our prose is worse'.

SEC M6 LEAK AUDIT: FAILS, AND IT IS A BIG HOLE. The `text` stripping rule in RI-MTH03 sec B says phrases matching morrowind/reference/etc. become [REDACTED]. ZERO [REDACTED] tokens exist in any of the 40 files - the stripping was never applied to these packs. Counting Tamriel setting proper nouns (Vvardenfell, Ebonheart, Vivec, Septim, Ashlander, Dunmer, Telvanni, Khajiit, Hircine ...) plus un-stripped wiki template residue (OBlink=, SRlink=, MWlink=Morrowind:) scores 17/20 with 3 ties - i.e. 17/17 on every decidable trial - WITHOUT READING A WORD. So the pack does not isolate prose and a naive judge could ace it illiterately.

CLEAN SUBSET: 3 trials where the name channel is uninformative (both sides zero setting nouns): r2 t10-dialogue, r2 t12-journal, voice t05-dialogue. I got 3/3 on cited prose evidence alone (combinatorial fragment recombination; branch-table vs literary-journal architecture; zero contractions + two-beat epigram). p=0.125 on that subset - suggestive, not conclusive. This is the only part of the 20/20 that is uncontaminated.

UN-STRIPPED WIKI RESIDUE also present on the reference side: t01-books/B.txt carries '|OBlink=OB:Brief History of the Empire, v 1|SRlink=SR:...' and blanked year fields ('conquered Roscrea in ,'); t03-books/B.txt carries 'MWlink=Morrowind:Dagoth Ur (god)'. These come from the UESP extract and are pipeline artefacts, not writing.
notes_for_successor: MUST answer packs BEFORE reading any answer key. Record answers to scratchpad first. Do not edit prose.
findings_3_rewrites: THE REWRITES MANUFACTURED A NEW TIC AND IT IS MEASURABLE. tools/prose/judge-fragment-openers.mjs (written by me, declared): sentence-initial 'Which' as a FRAGMENT runs at 0.94 per 10k in our shipped dialogue (7 genuine instances in 74,269 words) against Morrowind's 0.086 per 10k (16 instances in 1.87M words, and 12 of those 16 are one repeated line about not stealing ebony) = 11x. In the rewritten lines alone the raw sentence-initial-Which rate is 12.44/10k against Morrowind's 0.17 = 73x. The rewrite's operation was to promote a trailing relative clause to a sentence: 'It is grey, which is comforting' -> 'It's grey. Which is comforting.' That is a written-comic register, not a spoken one.

THE REWRITE IS ALSO VISIBLE AS A SEAM WITHIN OUR OWN CORPUS. Sentence-initial And in the 180 rewritten lines runs at 60.65 per 10k, against 12.39 across our whole shipped dialogue and 27.47 in Morrowind. So the rewritten lines are 4.9x denser in conjunction-openers than our own untouched lines and 2.2x denser than the reference. The pass over-applied on the lines it touched while leaving the corpus average at 0.45x Morrowind - a reader crossing from an untouched line to a rewritten one crosses a register boundary.

WHAT THE REWRITES ACTUALLY DID, from 20 sampled before/after pairs: three mechanical operations, applied together, on nearly every line. (a) contract every negation (is not->isn't, cannot->can't, have not->haven't); (b) split a long and-chain at its commas into separate sentences; (c) promote the trailing 'which is X' clause to a fragment. The UNDERLYING ARCHITECTURE IS UNCHANGED - the and-chain with an epigrammatic tail is still there, it has only been punctuated into pieces. 'It is grey and it is heavy and it does not go off for a week, dry-one, and I have been given it in nine settlements and it has been the same bread in all nine, which is comforting in a way I cannot explain.' became 'It's grey, it's heavy, and it doesn't go off for a week, dry-one. I've been given it in nine settlements and it's been the same bread in all nine. Which is comforting, in a way I can't explain.' Same clauses, same order, same closing epigram.

BUT THE REWRITES ARE NOT A FAILURE. They are a genuine improvement in mouthfeel and they moved a contraction-BLIND rule (SR-08 sentence-initial conjunction 7.57 -> 26.68 per 10k), which a find-and-replace could not have done. Live spoken-register.mjs now: SR-01 0.762, SR-05 0.748, BLIND-GAP +0.014. The verdict is 'a real pass that left one new fingerprint', not 'the same fingerprint in a hat'.

THE LARGEST REMAINING DIALOGUE DEFECT IS UNMOVED AND IT IS THE RIGHT ONE: SR-05 question mark 24.43 vs 158.83 per 10k = 0.2x. Our NPCs still almost never ask the player anything. In the blind trials this was the single most reliable reader-level tell - across 10 dialogue trials, the reference side asked the player questions in 9 and our side asked in 1.
method_deviations: Wrote tools/prose/judge-fragment-openers.mjs mid-run to answer 'did the rewrite trade one tell for another', which no existing tool measures. It has a --self-test with 7 assertions including two mutations: a relative-clause->fragment conversion MUST raise the Which count (it does), and a contraction swap MUST NOT move any opener count (it does not). Declared here per AGENT-PROTOCOL and RI-MTH03. I did not use it to grade anything I authored, because I authored no prose.
